behavior_changes.soft_agreement: Soft agreement asks whether to send the mockup; it does not capture email by itself.
behavior_changes.commitment: Accepted mockup or send signal asks for the best email.
behavior_changes.email_close: Email provided triggers normalized email confirmation only; buyer confirmation triggers one short close.
behavior_changes.gatekeeper: Gatekeeper note and callback close stay short with no extra value pitch.
behavior_changes.profile_ownership: Campaign profile keeps facts and capability statements, while prompt and overlay own runtime state behavior.
